entities.name: Nicholas Mahudel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolas Mahudel was a French antiquary interested in prehistoric research. He proposed the chronological prehistoric sequence Stone Age - Bronze Age - Iron Age. Mahudel was for a time a Jesuit and later in his life a Trappist.
